facts: The square white plastered stupa has an 8.5 m base and stepped tiers. The white body height is described as about 23.5 m. The viharn on the east is a four-gabled hall with orange and green glazed roof tiles. A separate old ordination hall lies south.

record: Fine Arts Department, Ministry of Culture
facts: The Lan Xang-era shrine encloses an older sanctuary. The structure is a named landmark in Sakon Nakhon.
The native stupa entry identifies the structure and records height 24 m.
